name: Handheld Quaker Mk 2

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters

disable: DC 22 Thievery check (trained) to deactivate the mechanism; DC 20 Crafting check (trained) to identify and repair the problem components; two successes are required to disable the hazard
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without a creature being within 5' of the handheld quaker.
routine:
At its initiative, to determine what the quaker does, roll 1d4 and consult the following table:
1: No action
2: A small quake: the terrain in a 10-foot emanation centered on the quaker shakes briefly. A creature in an affected square is knocked Prone (DC 21 Reflex save save).
3: A medium quake: the terrain within the vault shakes constantly, transforming it into difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is knocked prone and takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage from the fall (DC 21 basic Reflex save save).
4: A great quake: the terrain within the vault moves in waves, transforming it into greater difficult terrain until its next turn. A creature in an affected square is violently slammed to the ground, knocked prone and taking 2d8+6 bludgeoning damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Quake!
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into a space with the handheld quaker or interacts with it

---
Effect The handheld quaker vibrates visibly and rolls initiative.

items.name: Shaking Earth
items.text: A creature within difficult terrain created by the quaker takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves and actions with the Manipulate trait, including Disable Device.

text: This small toy-like device has a hidden mechanism meant to be activated by the user, but the centuries have eroded its magical-mechanical components to the point that they activate at the slightest touch.
